PraisonAI: AICoder Arbitrary File Write and Command Execution via LLM Tool Calls
### Summary
The `AICoder` UI component exposes `write_to_file` and `execute_command` tools to the LLM with no path validation and no command sanitization. An attacker can achieve arbitrary file write to any location on the filesystem (including `/root/.ssh/authorized_keys`, `/etc/crontab`) and arbitrary command execution through prompt injection in the chat interface. Docker containers run as root, maximizing impact.

fast-jwt: Incomplete patch of CVE-2026-34950: Non-whitespace key-prefix re-enables RSA→HS256 algorithm confusion
### Summary

The fix for CVE-2026-34950 (CVSS 9.1, released in v6.2.0) is **incomplete**. It adds `key.trim()` to the PEM-detection path in `src/crypto.js`, but `String.prototype.trim()` only strips characters classified as whitespace by the ECMAScript specification.
